note: Every file of the Nocturne design system matches exactly one rule below (first match wins). kind: skip and reference carry a reason; mirror and built require every target to exist; asset also requires identical bytes; tokens are compared value for value against the repo's token block; copy sources must have every sentence present in the rule's targets. `baseline` lists known gaps as kind:key. It can only shrink: a gap that closes must be removed, and a new one fails.
